signals.text: Love the chain it works great.
These are nice, comfy, have pockets and draw string. Very long in the legs, about four inches more than expected for size ordered. If you have a 36" inseam, these are for you.

Really good for mildly cold weather. 25 degrees F outside proved too cool for these in a short amount of time. Soft, fuzzy inside, silky smooth outer surface, wore very well under dress pants. Does have the expected fly opening.

label: chase
label_basis: real H&M sales in following 8 observed weeks
